scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "corepack pnpm --filter @grouppilot/api dev" "corepack pnpm --filter @grouppilot/web dev"
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @grouppilot/shared build && corepack pnpm --filter @grouppilot/api build && corepack pnpm --filter @grouppilot/web build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @grouppilot/shared typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @grouppilot/api typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @grouppilot/web typecheck
